shapes.name: realworld_call_and_expression_stack
shapes.notes: Stage 4 recovers CPython 3.11 logical COPY/SWAP stacks, nested and multiline conditional expressions, comparison chains, f-string values, ordinary callback lambdas, CALL/PRECALL/KW_NAMES evaluation order, and return values carried across loop/finally cleanup. Stage 6 exposes 11 deeper composite statement regions whose generic final failure is tracked explicitly by the real-world release policy without changing this verified core shape contract.

shapes.name: realworld_comprehension_and_iterator_protocol
shapes.notes: Stage 6 recovers incremental LIST_APPEND, SET_ADD, and MAP_ADD consumers; EXTENDED_ARG-prefixed FOR_ITER loops; terminal loop bodies; conditional comprehension outputs; Boolean and conditional filters; chained comparisons; closure generators; yield from; and generator lambdas. The fixed 604-file archive has no remaining comprehension/iterator-protocol failure classification.

shapes.name: realworld_exception_cleanup_control_transfer
shapes.notes: Stage 11 closes the remaining advanced nested exception-table layouts, including held return values across conditional and loop finally suites, handler returns through duplicated cleanup, deferred with returns, nested handlers, and protected while regions. Focused behavior tests plus the fixed 604-file replay retain zero real-world exception-cleanup failures.

shapes.name: realworld_import_protocol

shapes.name: realworld_match_boundary
shapes.notes: Stage 9 derives each case's physical end from pattern and guard failure edges, validates body ownership with dominators, validates shared exits with post-dominators, and rejects inconsistent join targets. The focused fixture covers the minimized tarfile module false positive plus guard, fallthrough, return, raise, conditional and nested match bodies; the fixed 604-file archive has no remaining match-boundary classification.

shapes.name: realworld_recursive_structure

The fixed 604-file archive has no remaining recursive-structure failure classification.

shapes.name: realworld_with_control_transfer
